architecture.desc: Decoupled Python analysis and Unity gameplay communicating via UDP/OSC ensures zero frame drops.
architecture.title: Decoupled Pipeline

ml.desc: Each person's beatbox sounds different. The system trains on your specific voice and microphone for maximum accuracy.
ml.title: Learns Your Voice

realtime.desc: Optimized audio buffer sizes and ML inference pipeline to stay well below the 60ms threshold for rhythm games.
realtime.title: Low Latency Response

hero.description: Control a rhythm game using only your voice. Make beatbox sounds like kick drums, snares, and hi-hats with your mouth, and the game responds in real-time. No controllers needed - just your voice and a microphone.

optimization.desc: Smaller audio chunks (512 samples), faster ML inference (RandomForest), and UDP-based OSC communication.
optimization.title: Optimization Strategy

spectral.desc: Kick drums are deep, snares have noise. I trained the system to recognize these spectral fingerprints along with temporal envelopes.
spectral.title: Spectral Analysis
